skill2: Restores Shield HP equal to 3.16% of the skill user's final Max HP every 1 sec continuously.

caveats: ⚑ skill1 team Attack Damage 10.41%: uptime assumed 100% from t=1s. The kit gates it on 'Full Charge maintained for more than 1 sec', which has NO engine analogue (no charge-hold state on a charge weapon — the sim charges and releases). Real uptime is bounded by how much of the fight she actually holds a completed charge; reload (141f datamined) and release windows break the hold. This is the OPTIMISTIC bound, not a measured value.

Both shield lines are authored target `self`, following the literal 'Affects self' clause, even though the prose says the shield is shared and protects all allies. Self-targeting satisfies this kit's own requiresShielded gate; if the shared shield also fires ALLY `shielded` triggers in game, the target must widen to `allies`. Widening is the over-crediting direction, so the conservative read is shipped.

'Current HP ▼ 2% every 1 sec' and 'Restores Shield HP … every 1 sec' are unmodeled: v1 models no HP pool and no shield HP pool, and the boss deals no damage, so both are no-ops at scope. The shield restore is deliberately NOT re-emitted as a per-second `shield` effect — that would fire `shielded` triggers ~180× over a fight and over-credit any shield-synergy consumer.

This kit carries NO damage effects. Her contribution is her own weapon damage plus the two team Attack Damage buffs (10.41% continuous + 15.24% for 10s on her own burst), both additive in the Damage Up bucket and therefore diluted by other support buffs.
Burst self Max HP ▲ 10.13% is kept for kit completeness; it is offensively inert unless a Max-HP→ATK conversion is present, and ally-granted Max HP does not feed a teammate's atkOfMaxHpPct.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. SR/Iron/Defender/Burst I charge weapon (ammo 6, chargeFrames 60, reloadFrames 141, hitsPerShot 1 — all datamined ⚑, cadence fields are the known-unreliable class). Offensive content is exactly two team Attack-Damage buffs: a continuous 10.41% (skill1, gated on the owner carrying a shield — self-supplied at battle start and re-supplied on her own burst cast) and a 15.24% burst-cast buff for 10 sec. Both shield lines are authored as `shield` effects with maxHpPct recorded for kit completeness (no shield HP pool at scope); they are load-bearing because they satisfy this kit's own requiresShielded gate and can drive shield-synergy consumers. The full-charge self-heal is emitted as a recovery event (no HP amount modeled) so on-recovery consumers (e.g. heal-gated ally buffs) fire per shot. ⚑ The 'Full Charge maintained for more than 1 sec' activation is modeled as an interval-1s permanent grant with 100% uptime after t=1s — see caveats; the true duty cycle is unmeasured. Trigger fidelity: 'when using Burst Skill' is keyed to burstCast (this unit's OWN cast), not fullBurstEnter.

flags.estimate: interval{sec:1}, permanent from t=1s → ~99% fight uptime (optimistic bound). A realistic hold-aware estimate could be materially lower.
flags.reasoning: 'Full Charge maintained for more than 1 sec' is a HELD-STATE condition; the engine has no charge-hold state — a charge weapon charges (60f) and releases. Nothing in the kit text states the uptime, so any number here is outside the input domain. True onset is also ≥ ~2s (1s charge + >1s hold), not 1s, and the condition presumably lapses across each release and each 141-frame reload.
